 How to Watch South Florida vs Florida Atlantic
 Date: Saturday, November 21, 2026
 Time: 2:30 PM ET
 Channel: ESPN+
 Stream: ESPN Unlimited ( watch now )
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Bulls enter the matchup at 6-4 following a 52-41 loss to Memphis, a game in which quarterback Luke Kromenhoek threw for 271 yards and three touchdowns while adding 146 rushing yards and another score. South Florida has dropped two consecutive games under head coach Brian Hartline but remains capable of producing explosive offensive performances. Running back D.J. Crowther has rushed for 689 yards and seven touchdowns this season, giving the Bulls another weapon in their backfield.
 – Live stream South Florida vs Florida Atlantic with ESPN Unlimited – 
 Florida Atlantic also enters at 6-4 after suffering a 38-21 defeat to Tulsa. Quarterback Caden Veltkamp has been outstanding for the Owls, throwing for more than 3,000 yards and 29 touchdowns this season. Wide receiver Easton Messer has surpassed 1,000 receiving yards, helping Florida Atlantic build one of the nation's most productive passing attacks. The Owls are undefeated at home this season and will look to maintain that record against their in-state rivals. Kickoff is scheduled for 2:30 PM ET on ESPN+.
